summary: Low-poly 3D tower defense at a seaside fortress, built by Claude Opus 5.5 · Sahil kalesinde alçak poligon 3D kule savunması, Claude Opus 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Three towers with three levels each: Archer Tower, Cannon Bastion with splash damage, Tar Cauldron that slows and burns
Four enemy types, including armoured Shieldbearers and a Battering Ram boss every 5th wave that costs 6 lives
Hold 20 lives for 15 waves, then endless mode; target modes, 70 % refund on sell, early-call bonus, 1x/2x/3x speed
The ?auto bot builds and upgrades on its own and falls on wave 15 in the measured run, with 0 JS errors
60 fps on an Intel UHD GPU at 1280x720 with 37-42 draw calls; generated models with a procedural fallback

social.headline: Hold a seaside fortress for 15 waves with archers, cannons and boiling tar · Okçu, top ve katranla sahil kalesini 15 dalga boyunca savun
